description: This file defines a Swift enum 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' providing static methods to interact with the iOS/macOS Keychain for storing, retrieving, and deleting generic password items associated with a service and account.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the keychain for the specified service and account.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the keychain item for the specified service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Internal method that retrieves raw data from the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Internal method that saves raw data to the keychain for the given service and account.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base query dictionary used for keychain operations.
